capabilities: Draw over a note with a pen, highlighter and eraser
Manage drawing layers with rename, hide, reorder and delete
Customize tool colour, size, opacity and stroke smoothing
Hold Shift to draw snapped straight lines
Undo and redo strokes, erases, clears and layer changes
extras: Not yet in the community plugin list; must be installed manually by copying main.js, manifest.json and styles.css into the plugins folder. Drawings are saved in the plugin's own data.json, not in the notes, and marks are pinned to page positions so they do not follow text edits.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to hand-draw or mark up a note in place while reading or reviewing it.
summary: Annotation tool that lets you draw with a pen, highlighter and eraser directly over your notes, margins included.
